Name: Spouses Have Standards
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
[size=6][b]Spouses Have Standards[/b][/size]

A small mod to make spouses have extra requirements before accepting a mermaid pendant

Shouldn't do anything for players on its own, you must install a mod that makes use of it first.

For modders intending to use it, see the [url=https://github.com/anotherpillow/spouseshavestandards#modders]README[/url].
